metadata.name: PublicHostPattern
metadata.description: A family of public hosts an application is reached at — tenant subdomains — as a pattern origin the host routes every matching host of to a port.

pattern.description: The hosts as a pattern origin: `https://*.tenants.example` (one or more whole labels) or `https://*-tenants.example` (a prefix of the first label).

port.description: The key of the root's `ports:` these hosts are served on, a `tcp` port.
